Be Part of the PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest! by: PCBWay Sep 03,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News We are glad to announce that PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest has arrived. Prior to this, PCBWay successfully held six design contests. In each contest, we saw many eye-catching projects shared by outstanding and creative electronic engineers and enthusiasts. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest will continue the previous purpose, which is to encourage more and more people to explore the charm of electronic design and participate in it. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . In this contest, in addition to the two themes of Electronic Project and Mechanical Project that have appeared before, we also introduced STM32 Project, hoping to give designers more room to perform. The contest will start on September 2nd, 2024, and project submissions will be accepted until January 19th, 2025. After this, the judging phase will begin, and the final winners will be announced on the PCBWay Blog on March 10th, 2025. Two ways to participate in the contest: Go to the contest page, find the Participate Now button and click it. In this case, the submitted project will automatically be entered into the competition; participants only need to select the theme of entry. Please note that if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. After filling in all the project information, simply click "Submit" at the bottom of the page. Go to the SharedProject Community ( https://www.pcbway.com/project/shareproject/ ) and click Create a project. Select the theme you are going to participate in. Similarly, if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. Hint: Sharing complete project files, including Gerber, BOM, Centroid file, schematics, 3D files, and so on will increase the chances of receiving a higher score. Awards and corresponding prizes: The First Prize : 1 winner, $1500 Cash + $200 Coupon + A Palm-sized Robot Dog*1 The Second Prize : 2 winners, $1000 Cash + $100 Coupon + Raspberry Pi 5 4GB *1 The Third Prize : 3 winners, $500 Cash + $50 Coupon + OpenMV4 H7 R2 Cam Smart Camera *1 Popular Design Prize : 10 winners, $100 Cash + $20 Coupon + $10 3D Printing Coupon + Multimeter ZTY890DPro *1 Participation Prize : Raspberry Pi Pico * 1 STM32 Great Project Prize : Six-Claw Multifunctional Aluminum Alloy Soldering Table *1 For more detailed information about the contest, please refer to: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . If there are any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment below.We wish you the best of luck and look forward to your innovative designs! Be Part of the PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest! by: PCBWay Sep 03,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News We are glad to announce that PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest has arrived. Prior to this, PCBWay successfully held six design contests. In each contest, we saw many eye-catching projects shared by outstanding and creative electronic engineers and enthusiasts. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest will continue the previous purpose, which is to encourage more and more people to explore the charm of electronic design and participate in it. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . In this contest, in addition to the two themes of Electronic Project and Mechanical Project that have appeared before, we also introduced STM32 Project, hoping to give designers more room to perform. The contest will start on September 2nd, 2024, and project submissions will be accepted until January 19th, 2025. After this, the judging phase will begin, and the final winners will be announced on the PCBWay Blog on March 10th, 2025. Two ways to participate in the contest: Go to the contest page, find the Participate Now button and click it. In this case, the submitted project will automatically be entered into the competition; participants only need to select the theme of entry. Please note that if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. After filling in all the project information, simply click "Submit" at the bottom of the page. Go to the SharedProject Community ( https://www.pcbway.com/project/shareproject/ ) and click Create a project. Select the theme you are going to participate in. Similarly, if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. Hint: Sharing complete project files, including Gerber, BOM, Centroid file, schematics, 3D files, and so on will increase the chances of receiving a higher score. Awards and corresponding prizes: The First Prize : 1 winner, $1500 Cash + $200 Coupon + A Palm-sized Robot Dog*1 The Second Prize : 2 winners, $1000 Cash + $100 Coupon + Raspberry Pi 5 4GB *1 The Third Prize : 3 winners, $500 Cash + $50 Coupon + OpenMV4 H7 R2 Cam Smart Camera *1 Popular Design Prize : 10 winners, $100 Cash + $20 Coupon + $10 3D Printing Coupon + Multimeter ZTY890DPro *1 Participation Prize : Raspberry Pi Pico * 1 STM32 Great Project Prize : Six-Claw Multifunctional Aluminum Alloy Soldering Table *1 For more detailed information about the contest, please refer to: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . If there are any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment below.We wish you the best of luck and look forward to your innovative designs! Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Verify Now Blog > Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay by: PCBWay May 30,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay recognizes the significant role it plays within the supply chain and broader society, along with the potential impact of its operations. To this end, we have established and strictly enforce the following principles, which not only govern our own conduct but also set clear expectations for our partners. Our goal is to ensure full legal and regulatory compliance, promote long-term sustainability, and generate a positive impact on society. Human Rights and Labor Protection No employment of individuals below the legal working age; all forms of forced or bonded labor are strictly prohibited. Discrimination and harassment in the workplace are not tolerated; an inclusive work environment for persons with disabilities is encouraged. Employees must be provided with fair compensation and reasonable rest periods, and their rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining must be respected. Business Ethics and Compliance Offering, promising, soliciting, or accepting any form of bribery is strictly prohibited; effective conflict of interest management and whistleblowing mechanisms must be in place. All financial and business records must accurately, completely, and truthfully reflect the underlying transactions. Full compliance with international sanctions, export controls, and other applicable laws and regulations is required. Supply Chain Responsibility and Sustainable Procurement PCBWay and its partners are required to extend the principles outlined in this document to all levels of entities within the supply chain. Priority should be given to selecting partners that are legally compliant, socially responsible, and committed to sustainable development. Identify social, labor, and environmental risks related to operations, and develop corresponding control and mitigation measures. Encourage partners to prioritize local sourcing to support regional economic development and job creation. Environmental Protection and Workplace Safety Actively implement environmental protection measures and continuously promote energy conservation and emission reduction; Ensure that all waste and hazardous materials are disposed of in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. The procurement or use of prohibited materials is not allowed. Provide employees with a safe working environment and health support mechanisms to prevent occupational injuries and health risks. PCBWay has fully adopted the DHL GoGreen transportation service in 2025 to reduce carbon emissions in the supply chain and promote the development of a green supply chain, with an initial target of reducing emissions by 30%. Information Protection and Transparent Governance Establish a comprehensive security system to strictly protect the confidentiality of customer data, drawings, and other business information. Comply with relevant laws and regulations to safeguard the personal data of customers and employees. Ensure that financial records are true, accurate, and complete, and prohibit any illegal activities. PCBWay will ensure the implementation of the above principles in actual cooperation and reserves the right to take action against any violations. Verify Now Blog > Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay by: PCBWay May 30,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay recognizes the significant role it plays within the supply chain and broader society, along with the potential impact of its operations. To this end, we have established and strictly enforce the following principles, which not only govern our own conduct but also set clear expectations for our partners. Our goal is to ensure full legal and regulatory compliance, promote long-term sustainability, and generate a positive impact on society. Human Rights and Labor Protection No employment of individuals below the legal working age; all forms of forced or bonded labor are strictly prohibited. Discrimination and harassment in the workplace are not tolerated; an inclusive work environment for persons with disabilities is encouraged. Employees must be provided with fair compensation and reasonable rest periods, and their rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining must be respected. Business Ethics and Compliance Offering, promising, soliciting, or accepting any form of bribery is strictly prohibited; effective conflict of interest management and whistleblowing mechanisms must be in place. All financial and business records must accurately, completely, and truthfully reflect the underlying transactions. Full compliance with international sanctions, export controls, and other applicable laws and regulations is required. Supply Chain Responsibility and Sustainable Procurement PCBWay and its partners are required to extend the principles outlined in this document to all levels of entities within the supply chain. Priority should be given to selecting partners that are legally compliant, socially responsible, and committed to sustainable development. Identify social, labor, and environmental risks related to operations, and develop corresponding control and mitigation measures. Encourage partners to prioritize local sourcing to support regional economic development and job creation. Environmental Protection and Workplace Safety Actively implement environmental protection measures and continuously promote energy conservation and emission reduction; Ensure that all waste and hazardous materials are disposed of in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. The procurement or use of prohibited materials is not allowed. Provide employees with a safe working environment and health support mechanisms to prevent occupational injuries and health risks. PCBWay has fully adopted the DHL GoGreen transportation service in 2025 to reduce carbon emissions in the supply chain and promote the development of a green supply chain, with an initial target of reducing emissions by 30%. Information Protection and Transparent Governance Establish a comprehensive security system to strictly protect the confidentiality of customer data, drawings, and other business information. Comply with relevant laws and regulations to safeguard the personal data of customers and employees. Ensure that financial records are true, accurate, and complete, and prohibit any illegal activities. PCBWay will ensure the implementation of the above principles in actual cooperation and reserves the right to take action against any violations. For further inquiries, please contact: logistics@pcbway.com Update on May 12th The Government of the United States of America (the “United States”) and the Government of the People’s Republic of China (“China”), Recognizing the importance of their bilateral economic and trade relationship to both countries and the global economy; Recognizing the importance of a sustainable, long-term, and mutually beneficial economic and trade relationship; Reflecting on their recent discussions and believing that continued discussions have the potential to address the concerns of each side in their economic and trade relationship; and Moving forward in the spirit of mutual opening, continued communication, cooperation, and mutual respect; The Parties commit to take the following actions by May 14, 2025 : The United States will (i) modify the application of the additional ad valorem rate of duty on articles of China (including articles of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macau Special Administrative Region) set forth in Executive Order 14257 of April 2, 2025, by suspending 24 percentage points of that rate for an initial period of 90 days, while retaining the remaining ad valorem rate of 10 percent on those articles pursuant to the terms of said Order; and (ii) removing the modified additional ad valorem rates of duty on those articles imposed by Executive Order 14259 of April 8, 2025 and Executive Order 14266 of April 9, 2025. China will (i) modify accordingly the application of the additional ad valorem rate of duty on articles of the United States set forth in Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 4 of 2025, by suspending 24 percentage points of that rate for an initial period of 90 days, while retaining the remaining additional ad valorem rate of 10 percent on those articles, and removing the modified additional ad valorem rates of duty on those articles imposed by Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 5 of 2025 and Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 6 of 2025; and (ii) adopt all necessary administrative measures to suspend or remove the non-tariff countermeasures taken against the United States since April 2, 2025. After taking the aforementioned actions, the Parties will establish a mechanism to continue discussions about economic and trade relations. The representative from the Chinese side for these discussions will be He Lifeng, Vice Premier of the State Council, and the representatives from the U.S. side will be Scott Bessent, Secretary of the Treasury, and Jamieson Greer, United States Trade Representative. These discussions may be conducted alternately in China and the United States, or a third country upon agreement of the Parties. As required, the two sides may conduct working-level consultations on relevant economic and trade issues. https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/2025/05/joint-statement-on-u-s-china-economic-and-trade-meeting-in-geneva/ Updated on April 25th **Presidential Executive Order on Tariff Adjustments for Chinese Goods** On April 8, 2025 (local time), U.S. President Donald Trump issued an executive order announcing the following tariff measures on goods originating from China (including Hong Kong, China): 1. **Elimination of De Minimis Exemption for Chinese-origin Goods** 2. **Additional 125%+20% (If it is the category under 9903.01.32 or 9903.01.33, the tariff exemption is 125%) Tariff on High-value Chinese Goods** 3.Fedex Official: For B2C shipments, a valid FedEx account number is required. 4.If the product falls under HTS categories 9903.01.32 or 9903.01.33, it qualifies for a 125% tariff exemption. However, DHL’s customs declaration system may inaccurately apply or fail to recognize the 125% exemption. If the recipient finds that the product is indeed eligible for the exemption but the 125% duty relief was not applied, they must file a dispute with DHL immediately, as there is a strict deadline for appeals. By the time the sender notices the issue, the appeal window may have already closed. Note: Regarding why your social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number is needed when shipping, please check out this official article for explanation: Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? ============================================================================================== by the way： Importers - Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? When an individual or company purchases goods from an overseas supplier, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) considers them the ultimate importer. The ultimate importer can clear the goods or have a Customs Broker clear them on their behalf. If the supplier hires a carrier that provides door to door service, the carrier service usually has brokers in their supply chain to clear the goods on behalf of the ultimate importer. If a formal entry is required, CBP regulations require the broker to put the ultimate importer's identification number on the CBP Form 7501- Entry Summary. The ultimate importer's identification number is either the Employers Identification Number (EIN) tax identification number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) or the importer's social security number. The EIN is issued for the purpose of tax administration and are not intended for participation in any other activities (e.g., tax lien auction or sales, lotteries). For additional information about EIN, please visit the IRS web page "Apply for an Employer Identification (EIN) Online." Goods are usually cleared informally when they are for personal use, under $2500 in value, and are not in commercial quantities. A formal entry is usually required for commercial importations valued over $2,500. Because many foreign merchants are aware that CBP requires an identification number for the ultimate importer for formal entries, they will often request the purchaser's social security number to include on export documents that the broker will subsequently rely on to prepare the CBP entry. It should be noted that paperwork for goods sent by courier service does ask for an importer number, whether the import qualifies for an informal entry or not. Courier services file CBP entries electronically, and the software system they use requires an identification number to be provided for the recipient of the goods. If an identification number is not provided, the courier service is required to file a paper entry, which is extremely time-consuming and in the world of "Overnight Delivery" not practical. The end result is that most courier services will not accept packages for international delivery to U.S. residents if a recipient's identification number is not provided by the shipper. Goods sent through the international postal service that are under $2500 in value generally do not require an importer number to be cleared through CBP. Date Published 2025/1/22 ====================================================================================================== Updated on April 17th 10th 9th ： **Presidential Executive Order on Tariff Adjustments for Chinese Goods** On April 8, 2025 (local time), U.S. President Donald Trump issued an executive order announcing the following tariff measures on goods originating from China (including Hong Kong, China): 1. **Elimination of De Minimis Exemption for Chinese-origin Goods** For goods shipped via international postal networks: (1) Effective May 2, 2025 at 12:01 AM EST: A tariff rate of 120 % 90% of the goods' declared value will be applied. (2) From May 2, 2025 at 12:01 AM EST through June 1, 2025 at 12:01 AM EST: A flat tariff of $100 $75 per item will be imposed. (3) Effective June 1, 2025 at 12:01 AM EST: The flat tariff will increase to $200 $150 per item. 2. **Additional 125%+20% (If it is the category under 9903.01.32 or 9903.01.33 , the tariff exemption is 125% ) 104% Tariff on High-value Chinese Goods** For Chinese-origin goods valued over $800: Effective April 9, 2025 at 12:01 AM EST: An additional tariff of 125% 104% will be applied to these products. 3.If the product falls under HTS categories 9903.01.32 or 9903.01.33, it qualifies for a 125% tariff exemption. However, DHL’s customs declaration system may inaccurately apply or fail to recognize the 125% exemption. If the recipient finds that the product is indeed eligible for the exemption but the 125% duty relief was not applied, they must file a dispute with DHL immediately, as there is a strict deadline for appeals. By the time the sender notices the issue, the appeal window may have already closed. 4.Fedex Official: For B2C shipments, a valid FedEx account number is required. Note: All times mentioned are in U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST). The exemption scope of 9903.01.32 includes semiconductors, as well as some goods listed by the United States within the HS list. The applicable exemption scope of 9903.01.33 includes automobiles and some parts and components, and it is related to the Section 232 list. 9903.01.63 refers to goods other than those within the scopes of 9903.01.32 and 9903.01.33, and an additional 125% tariff will be imposed on them. =============================================================================================================================================== How Much Are Tariffs on Chinese Goods? It’s Trickier Than You Think. But because of an ever-changing patchwork of trade rules, not every product will be charged an astronomical tariff, trade lawyers, customs brokers and importers say. In some cases, tariffs will pile on other tariffs. In other instances, they can reduce costs, while other times they can cancel out new ones. The new 125 percent rate that President Trump imposed will in many cases be added on top of long-existing duties. There are four main categories of tariffs that are imposed on goods from China. Note: The tariff on auto parts comes into effect in early May. The average provided for the base rate is calculated by the World Trade Organization, which computes an average of all tariff lines. A large share of U.S. imports are assigned a 0% duty, but there are some very high rates in the tariff schedule. Rates ultimately depend on what is imported, what materials are used (from where), which special rates are applied and what sorts of products are exempt. New tariff rates on select goods from China Note: Rates are rounded to the nearest whole number. Details: On February 3, 2025 (Eastern Time), the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) announced additional tariffs on imported products originating from China (including Hong Kong). Regardless of their value, all covered imported products will be assessed, and shipments containing such goods will no longer be eligible for the "de minimis" duty and tax exemption under 19 U.S.C. § 1321(a)(2)(C). Note: Regarding why your social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number is needed when shipping, please check out this official article for explanation: Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? ============================================================================================== by the way： Importers - Why is an overseas supplier asking for my social security number/tax ID number/IRS number/importer number? When an individual or company purchases goods from an overseas supplier, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) considers them the ultimate importer. The ultimate importer can clear the goods or have a Customs Broker clear them on their behalf. If the supplier hires a carrier that provides door to door service, the carrier service usually has brokers in their supply chain to clear the goods on behalf of the ultimate importer. If a formal entry is required, CBP regulations require the broker to put the ultimate importer's identification number on the CBP Form 7501- Entry Summary. The ultimate importer's identification number is either the Employers Identification Number (EIN) tax identification number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) or the importer's social security number. The EIN is issued for the purpose of tax administration and are not intended for participation in any other activities (e.g., tax lien auction or sales, lotteries). For additional information about EIN, please visit the IRS web page "Apply for an Employer Identification (EIN) Online." Goods are usually cleared informally when they are for personal use, under $2500 in value, and are not in commercial quantities. A formal entry is usually required for commercial importations valued over $2,500. Because many foreign merchants are aware that CBP requires an identification number for the ultimate importer for formal entries, they will often request the purchaser's social security number to include on export documents that the broker will subsequently rely on to prepare the CBP entry. It should be noted that paperwork for goods sent by courier service does ask for an importer number, whether the import qualifies for an informal entry or not. Courier services file CBP entries electronically, and the software system they use requires an identification number to be provided for the recipient of the goods. If an identification number is not provided, the courier service is required to file a paper entry, which is extremely time-consuming and in the world of "Overnight Delivery" not practical. The end result is that most courier services will not accept packages for international delivery to U.S. residents if a recipient's identification number is not provided by the shipper. Goods sent through the international postal service that are under $2500 in value generally do not require an importer number to be cleared through CBP. Visitors are welcome to meet the PCBWay team at Booth 311 and explore our PCB and electronics manufacturing capabilities. Visit PCBWay at Booth 311 As one of the major events for the electronics design and manufacturing industry, PCB West brings together PCB designers, engineers, fabricators, assemblers, and other professionals from across the electronics supply chain. The 2026 conference runs from September 29 to October 2, with the exhibition taking place on September 30. Event: PCB West 2026 Date: September 30, 2026 Venue: Santa Clara Convention Center, Santa Clara, California Booth: 311 Explore PCB and Electronics Manufacturing Solutions PCB development often involves more than PCB fabrication alone. Design, component sourcing, assembly, testing, and manufacturing all need to work together to bring a project from concept to a finished product. At PCB West 2026, visitors can talk with the PCBWay team about solutions covering different stages of the development and manufacturing process, including: PCB fabrication and prototyping PCB assembly and component sourcing PCB design and layout Advanced and multilayer PCB manufacturing Electronics manufacturing solutions Our team can also discuss specific project requirements and help identify suitable manufacturing options based on your design, application, and production needs. Connect with PCBWay at PCB West 2026 PCB West has been bringing together professionals from the PCB design, fabrication, and assembly industries for more than 30 years. The 2026 event will feature more than 100 exhibiting companies and is expected to attract thousands of designers, engineers, fabricators, and assemblers. If you are attending PCB West 2026, stop by Booth 311 to meet the PCBWay team, see what we can offer, and discuss your next electronics project. Learn more about PCB West 2026. Meet PCBWay at electronica 2024! by: PCBWay Oct 18,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Once again, we welcome the famous technology event electronica in Munich, Germany! Since the first exhibition was held in 1964, electronica has gradually grown and now covers the entire world of electronics, including the micro- and nano-worlds of semiconductor and micro systems technology, as well as measurement and sensor technology, display technology and vehicle electronics, etc., which is the best choice for any technology enthusiasts and industry practitioners. PCBWay has participated in theelectronica many times and has received a warm response every time. At the exhibition, everyone has the opportunity to get close to our various products and fully evaluate the performance and quality of our products, which is far beyond the scope of online communication. On-site interaction gives us the opportunity to answer everyone's questions in a timely manner and help them understand the products more comprehensively, thereby accelerating the process of cooperation. Therefore, after the exhibition, we not only strengthened our cooperation with existing customers, but also successfully attracted the attention of many new potential partners. PCBWay will certainly not be absent from this year's exhibition.In addition, in order to give everyone a better exhibition experience and also to show how much importance PCBWay attaches to this exhibition, this year we made some innovations: Time: 2024.11.12-2024.11.15 Location: Trade Fair Center Messe München, Germany PCBWay Booth No.: A1.163 Highlights: Color- printed Boards In addition to the PCB series products, 3D printed parts and sheet metal parts that we have been displaying in the past, we will also bring the latest color-printed board samples. This new product has attracted the attention and interest of many customers, so we hope to take this opportunity to let everyone experience the excellent effect and quality of the color-printed board in person. New Booth We focused on designing the on-site booth as well. We expanded the booth area to 5m x 14m, providing a larger activity space, and also improved the sophistication of various details, in order to make the overall atmosphere more professional and make everyone's visiting experience more comfortable. The final booth design renderings are as follows: Gifts We will also bring some small gifts to the exhibition, including water cups, neck masks, and T-shirts. Welcome to come and get them! Map: Also, we've prepared some free tickets, click the link and apply for them! https://tickets.messe-muenchen.de/MM/ELE24/Register/PCBWay_2024 Sorry, the 100+ current tickets are "sold out". We welcome you to our booth to receive gifts PCBWay will continue the past successful experience, bring more innovative products and solutions. We welcome you to visit our booth and witness PCBWay's innovation and growth! We’ve got everything ready, just wait for your arrival. ;) Exhibition Moments Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Meet PCBWay at electronica 2024! by: PCBWay Oct 18,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Once again, we welcome the famous technology event electronica in Munich, Germany! Since the first exhibition was held in 1964, electronica has gradually grown and now covers the entire world of electronics, including the micro- and nano-worlds of semiconductor and micro systems technology, as well as measurement and sensor technology, display technology and vehicle electronics, etc., which is the best choice for any technology enthusiasts and industry practitioners. PCBWay has participated in theelectronica many times and has received a warm response every time. At the exhibition, everyone has the opportunity to get close to our various products and fully evaluate the performance and quality of our products, which is far beyond the scope of online communication. On-site interaction gives us the opportunity to answer everyone's questions in a timely manner and help them understand the products more comprehensively, thereby accelerating the process of cooperation. Therefore, after the exhibition, we not only strengthened our cooperation with existing customers, but also successfully attracted the attention of many new potential partners. PCBWay will certainly not be absent from this year's exhibition.In addition, in order to give everyone a better exhibition experience and also to show how much importance PCBWay attaches to this exhibition, this year we made some innovations: Time: 2024.11.12-2024.11.15 Location: Trade Fair Center Messe München, Germany PCBWay Booth No.: A1.163 Highlights: Color- printed Boards In addition to the PCB series products, 3D printed parts and sheet metal parts that we have been displaying in the past, we will also bring the latest color-printed board samples. This new product has attracted the attention and interest of many customers, so we hope to take this opportunity to let everyone experience the excellent effect and quality of the color-printed board in person. New Booth We focused on designing the on-site booth as well. We expanded the booth area to 5m x 14m, providing a larger activity space, and also improved the sophistication of various details, in order to make the overall atmosphere more professional and make everyone's visiting experience more comfortable. The final booth design renderings are as follows: Gifts We will also bring some small gifts to the exhibition, including water cups, neck masks, and T-shirts. Welcome to come and get them! Map: Also, we've prepared some free tickets, click the link and apply for them! https://tickets.messe-muenchen.de/MM/ELE24/Register/PCBWay_2024 Sorry, the 100+ current tickets are "sold out". We welcome you to our booth to receive gifts PCBWay will continue the past successful experience, bring more innovative products and solutions. We welcome you to visit our booth and witness PCBWay's innovation and growth! We’ve got everything ready, just wait for your arrival. ;) Exhibition Moments Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Thank you to all participants for bringing your creativity, passion, and engineering expertise to life to celebrate 12 years of innovation with PCBWay! 1. Prize: $500 Cash + $300 PCBWay Coupon 2. Most Popular Award (1 Winner) Design Name: Striped Horse Author: @Epishko Dmitry Description: PCB horse floral badge with running LED chasing light effect. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon 3. Second Prize (2 Winners) Design Name: Sci-Fi Badge Author: @Juan Carlos jsbalanzar Description: Breathing LED living tech badge with lamp charger RFID customization. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon Design Name: Neon Marquee Author: @Guiye Perez Bongiovanni Description: 2-layer 1.6mm PCB badge with green LEDs and ATtiny85 firmware. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon Congratulations to all the winners! Prizes and coupons will be issued soon. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Unlock Color PCB Printing with PCBWay! by: PCBWay Mar 08,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Color PCB Printing PCBWay Service Nowadays, traditional PCB printing technology can no longer meet the aesthetic requirements of modern circuit board production. To better fulfill customers' design needs, we are pleased to announce that PCBWay has introduced UV printing equipment. This equipment utilizes UV-curable inks to achieve high-quality image printing on various materials, including fiberglass boards, metal substrates, ceramic substrates, flexible boards, and rigid-flex boards. Entrance https://www.pcbway.com/orderonline.aspx Prerequisites for Ordering Maximum size for a single piece: 270*470MM; Selection of background soldermask color required. Design Specifications Drill holes, traces, soldermasks, and outline designs must comply with specifications. Avoid placing colored characters in areas with solder mask openings, such as surface-mount pads or through-hole pads. What kind of files should be provided for color printing? Method One : Draw colored characters on the silkscreen layer of the Gerber and provide reference pictures. For example: Method Two : If you include information about colored silkscreen in the Gerber layer, each individual color must have its own layer. If there is only one layer, we can only print one color. [This method is not recommended] . If you need to print in multiple colors, we recommend using method One and providing us with a reference picture. 4.Please send the images you want to print on the PCB in the following formats: AI, PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, etc., and indicate your desired printing location on the board. 5.If the image contains a QR code, please ensure that the QR code can be accurately scanned and recognized. Note : If you choose UV printing Multi-color, we will use matte UV color printing by default. When designing the colored characters on the bottom layer, be careful not to design the colored characters as mirrored inverses. (The process of color printing is different from that of standard PCB silkscreen printing. When printing colorful characters on the bottom layer, they are printed with the bottom layer of the PCB facing up.) For situations where the entire top or bottom side requires full-color printing, regardless of the solder mask color you choose, we will use a white solder mask on the full-color printed side and then proceed with the color printing. This is for a better printing effect. Please upload the print image, positioning image, and Gerber in one compressed file. By providing a clear positioning image and necessary instructions, you can assist PCBWay in accurately determining and achieving the desired printing position. Matte UV Color Printing vs. Glossy UV Color Printing Matte ink does not increase the overall thickness, and the PCB's appearance looks smooth. Glossy ink increases the overall thickness and may affect the soldering of component pads. The appearance is beautiful but uneven. Features Adopting UV-LED lamp curing, which enables instant drying, can significantly enhances production efficiency. UV printing technology employs UV-curable inks, ensuring firm and clear printing information resistant to fading, thus enhancing product identification and aesthetics. The normal print survives SMT reflow. UV printing technology can present images in various colors and styles, meeting customers' personalized requirements. Professional industrial-grade UV printers support high-precision printing, delivering exquisite results whether on flat panels or rolled materials. Unlike traditional printing methods, UV printing does not produce volatile organic compounds during the production process, ensuring air quality in the production workshop and providing employees with a safer and healthier working environment. FAQ on UV Printing: Can the UV printed surface be cleaned with water? Yes, it can be cleaned with water. Can the UV printed surface be cleaned with alcohol? It is more difficult to clean after being exposed to alcohol and baked (currently, the board undergoes a short baking process after UV printing). However, with increased contact time with alcohol and vigorous scrubbing, it can be removed. This also depends on whether the UV is on the copper surface or the solder mask surface. How hard is the UV printed surface (sensitivity to scratches)? The UV surface is not sensitive to scratches. However, compared to the solder mask, it is less scratch-resistant because UV printing is ink that is sprayed on and is relatively thin. Welcome to give it a try if you're interested! Besides, PCBWay will continue to enhance its manufacturing capabilities to bring more choices and personalized services to customers in the future. Unlock Color PCB Printing with PCBWay! by: PCBWay Mar 08,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Color PCB Printing PCBWay Service Nowadays, traditional PCB printing technology can no longer meet the aesthetic requirements of modern circuit board production. To better fulfill customers' design needs, we are pleased to announce that PCBWay has introduced UV printing equipment. This equipment utilizes UV-curable inks to achieve high-quality image printing on various materials, including fiberglass boards, metal substrates, ceramic substrates, flexible boards, and rigid-flex boards. Entrance https://www.pcbway.com/orderonline.aspx Prerequisites for Ordering Maximum size for a single piece: 270*470MM; Selection of background soldermask color required. Design Specifications Drill holes, traces, soldermasks, and outline designs must comply with specifications. Avoid placing colored characters in areas with solder mask openings, such as surface-mount pads or through-hole pads. What kind of files should be provided for color printing? Method One : Draw colored characters on the silkscreen layer of the Gerber and provide reference pictures. For example: Method Two : If you include information about colored silkscreen in the Gerber layer, each individual color must have its own layer. If there is only one layer, we can only print one color. [This method is not recommended] . If you need to print in multiple colors, we recommend using method One and providing us with a reference picture. 4.Please send the images you want to print on the PCB in the following formats: AI, PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, etc., and indicate your desired printing location on the board. 5.If the image contains a QR code, please ensure that the QR code can be accurately scanned and recognized. Note : If you choose UV printing Multi-color, we will use matte UV color printing by default. When designing the colored characters on the bottom layer, be careful not to design the colored characters as mirrored inverses. (The process of color printing is different from that of standard PCB silkscreen printing. When printing colorful characters on the bottom layer, they are printed with the bottom layer of the PCB facing up.) For situations where the entire top or bottom side requires full-color printing, regardless of the solder mask color you choose, we will use a white solder mask on the full-color printed side and then proceed with the color printing. This is for a better printing effect. Please upload the print image, positioning image, and Gerber in one compressed file. By providing a clear positioning image and necessary instructions, you can assist PCBWay in accurately determining and achieving the desired printing position. Matte UV Color Printing vs. Glossy UV Color Printing Matte ink does not increase the overall thickness, and the PCB's appearance looks smooth. Glossy ink increases the overall thickness and may affect the soldering of component pads. The appearance is beautiful but uneven. Features Adopting UV-LED lamp curing, which enables instant drying, can significantly enhances production efficiency. UV printing technology employs UV-curable inks, ensuring firm and clear printing information resistant to fading, thus enhancing product identification and aesthetics. The normal print survives SMT reflow. UV printing technology can present images in various colors and styles, meeting customers' personalized requirements. Professional industrial-grade UV printers support high-precision printing, delivering exquisite results whether on flat panels or rolled materials. Unlike traditional printing methods, UV printing does not produce volatile organic compounds during the production process, ensuring air quality in the production workshop and providing employees with a safer and healthier working environment. FAQ on UV Printing: Can the UV printed surface be cleaned with water? Yes, it can be cleaned with water. Can the UV printed surface be cleaned with alcohol? It is more difficult to clean after being exposed to alcohol and baked (currently, the board undergoes a short baking process after UV printing). However, with increased contact time with alcohol and vigorous scrubbing, it can be removed. This also depends on whether the UV is on the copper surface or the solder mask surface. How hard is the UV printed surface (sensitivity to scratches)? The UV surface is not sensitive to scratches. However, compared to the solder mask, it is less scratch-resistant because UV printing is ink that is sprayed on and is relatively thin. Welcome to give it a try if you're interested! Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - M5StackChan AI Desktop Robot PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - M5StackChan AI Desktop Robot by: PCBWay Sep 24,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCBWay Store Link： AI Desktop Robot StackChan is a super kawaii AI desktop robot co-created by M5Stack and the user community. It uses the M5Stack flagship IoT development kit CoreS3 as its main controller, powered by an ESP32-S3 SoC featuring a 240 MHz dual-core processor, with 16MB Flash and 8MB PSRAM onboard, and supporting Wi-Fi and BLE. The main unit also integrates a 2.0-inch capacitive touch display with a high-strength glass cover, a 0.3 MP camera, a proximity & ambient light sensor, a 9-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope + magnetometer), a microSD card slot, a 1W speaker, dual microphones, and power/reset buttons. The robot body, connected to the main unit, includes a USB-C interface for power and data, a 550 mAh battery, two feedback servos (360-degree continuous rotation on the horizontal axis and 90-degree movement on the vertical axis), two rows totaling 12 RGB LEDs, infrared transmitter and receiver, a three-zone touch panel, and a full-featured NFC module. The factory firmware is feature-rich, including an AI Agent, lively and expressive animations, ESP-NOW wireless remote control, and online app downloads. It can connect to a mobile app for video viewing, remote avatar control, and more, and also supports online updates (OTA). The product also supports programming via Arduino, UiFlow2, and other methods, and can connect to various expansion units in the M5Stack ecosystem, making it easy to implement a wide range of custom functions. Note: Includes 1 x Carrying bag or box (depending on the purchased product bundle) 1 x StackChan unit (with CoreS3 pre-installed) 1 x 50cm USB-A to USB-C Cable 1 x Character expression sticker 1 x Printed user manual Learn and Documents → DOCUMENTS Features Based on the CoreS3 main unit For detailed information, please refer to the CoreS3 page Robot body USB-C interface for power and data 550 mAh battery Two feedback servos (360-degree continuous rotation on the horizontal axis and 90-degree movement on the vertical axis) Two rows totaling 12 RGB LEDs Infrared transmitter and receiver Top-mounted three-zone touch panel Full-featured NFC Development platforms UiFlow2 Arduino IDE PlatformIO ESP-IDF Application Scenarios Desktop companion AI agent Voice-based question and answer Smart home IoT control Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - M5Stack CoreS3 ESP32S3 IoT Development Kit PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - M5Stack CoreS3 ESP32S3 IoT Development Kit by: PCBWay Oct 08,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCBWay Store Link： CoreS3 CoreS3 is the third-generation main controller of the M5Stack development kit series, based on the ESP32-S3 solution featuring a dual-core Xtensa LX7 processor running at 240 MHz with built-in Wi-Fi. It integrates 16MB Flash and 8MB PSRAM. Programs can be downloaded through the USB Type-C port, and OTG & CDC functions are supported for connecting USB devices and flashing firmware. The front houses a 2.0-inch capacitive-touch IPS panel protected by high-strength glass. Below the screen is a 0.3MP GC0308 camera paired with an LTR-553ALS-WA proximity sensor. Power is managed by an AXP2101 PMU and four power-path control circuits, delivering a low-power design. Onboard sensors include a six-axis IMU BMI270 and a magnetometer BMM150. Additional peripherals comprise a microSD slot and a BM8563 RTC, enabling precise time-keeping plus sleep/timed-wake-up functions. For audio, a 16-bit I2S amplifier AW88298 drives the built-in 1W speaker, while an ES7210 audio codec provides dual-microphone input. Independent POWER and RESET (RST) buttons are located on the side; long-pressing the RESET button enters download mode via a self-built delay circuit. The kit ships with a DinBase for DIN-rail, wall-mount or screw mounting. It can be powered by an external DC 12V (9 ~ 24V) supply or an internal 500mAh Li-ion battery. Multiple proto areas on the DinBase ease DIY expansion. Ideal for IoT development, DIY projects, smart-home control systems and industrial automation control systems. WiFi 6 offers higher speeds, greater capacity, lower latency, and enhanced security compared to previous WiFi protocols. It is equipped with an ESP32-C6FH4 SoC, supporting wireless communication technologies such as Wi-Fi 6 and ZigBee, and features a built-in infrared transmitter for convenient control of infrared IoT devices. The onboard ceramic antenna ensures a stable wireless communication connection. Additionally, the device is equipped with programmable RGB LEDs, allowing for personalized visual effects in projects. The inclusion of a Grove interface enables flexible expansion with various M5 devices (customizable to connect different types of devices, such as those following UART/I2C communication protocols), providing developers with rich hardware expansion possibilities. This development board is suitable for smart homes, industrial automation, health monitoring, and IoT devices, offering a comprehensive development solution for innovative projects. WiFi 6 M5NanoC6 is the first core control board to support WiFi 6, supporting the 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6 protocol (802.11ax) and backward compatibility with 802.11 b/g/n. WiFi 6 offers higher speeds, greater capacity, lower latency, and enhanced security compared to previous WiFi protocols. Verify Now Blog > Analog vs Digital Circuits: Understanding Digital, Analog, and Mixed-Signal Chips Analog vs Digital Circuits: Understanding Digital, Analog, and Mixed-Signal Chips by: Mila Sep 30,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCB Design & Layout analog vs digital circuits analog and digital circuits analog circuits digital circuits mixed signal PCB design We often say that the world of chips consists of only 0s and 1s. But more accurately, digital circuits use defined voltage ranges to represent discrete logic states, while the real world is clearly not like that. Human voices have different volumes, light has different levels of brightness, temperature changes continuously, and radio waves do not simply jump between 0 V and 1 V. So here is the question: If CPUs mainly process digital data, how can a smartphone hear sound, capture photos, connect to a cellular network, and charge its battery? The answer lies in three types of chips: digital chips, analog chips, and mixed-signal chips. Understanding the differences between them is also important for PCB layout , because digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuits have different requirements for signal integrity, grounding, power, and noise control. （class B analog audio amplifier） Analog vs Digital Circuits: What Is the Difference? The key difference between analog vs digital circuits is how they represent and process signals. Digital signals focus on discrete states. In a typical digital circuit, voltage is divided into high and low ranges, which are interpreted as 1 and 0. As long as the signal remains within the specified range, small amounts of noise usually do not change the logic result. Analog signals, on the other hand, preserve continuous changes. The small voltage generated by a microphone, the radio-frequency signal received by an antenna, changes in temperature detected by a sensor, and the voltage and current during battery charging and discharging can all vary continuously over time and amplitude. A simple way to understand analog and digital circuits is: A digital signal is like written text. It mainly cares about which character is being represented. An analog signal is like speech. It contains not only information, but also volume, tone, speed, and many subtle changes. In other words, digital circuits are good at processing discrete information, while analog circuits directly interact with continuously changing signals from the real world. （Analog vs Digital Signals） Digital Chips: Computing, Control, and Memory Digital chips are best suited to problems that can be clearly defined and represented as discrete data. Common digital chips include: CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs; MCUs and various controllers; DRAM, SRAM, and NAND Flash; FPGAs; Digital interface and network processing chips. Digital circuits are built from large numbers of logic gates, flip-flops, registers, and memory cells. Driven by a clock, data flows and is processed according to defined rules. Their biggest advantage is their high level of abstraction. Engineers can move from transistors to logic gates, then to adders, processors, instructions, and software. This allows complex systems to be designed, verified, and optimized at different levels of abstraction. Digital chips are particularly suitable for: Executing programs; Storing data; Implementing complex control functions; Performing large-scale logic and mathematical operations; Precisely coordinating different functions within a system. However, digital circuits themselves cannot directly process continuously changing analog signals. A CPU cannot simply take the tiny analog voltage generated by a microphone and process it as digital data. Nor can it directly turn a string of binary data into the continuous analog signal needed to drive a speaker. This is where analog circuits and mixed-signal circuits come in. Analog Chips: Connecting Electronics to the Real World Analog chips process continuously changing voltages and currents. They do not necessarily focus on extremely large amounts of digital logic, but they often determine whether a device can hear clearly, measure accurately, transmit effectively, and charge efficiently. Typical analog and analog-intensive chips include: Operational amplifiers and comparators; Voltage references and analog front ends; Power management chips such as LDOs and DC-DC converters; Audio amplifiers; Analog circuits used in RF front ends. The problems that analog circuits need to solve are very much connected to the real world: How do you amplify a weak signal? How do you filter out unwanted noise? How do you keep an output voltage stable? How do you maintain performance when temperature and supply voltage change? Analog design is challenging because many real-world details cannot simply be abstracted away. Transistor characteristics, temperature, noise, power-supply fluctuations, parasitic resistance, and parasitic capacitance can all affect the final result. Digital circuits mainly need to determine whether a signal should be recognized as 1 or 0, so many small variations can be tolerated. Analog circuits, however, often need to pay close attention to the actual signal amplitude, noise, distortion, and offset. For example, for an analog amplifier, whether the output is 0.999 V or 1.001 V may affect the final measurement or control result. Mixed-Signal Chips: Bridging the Analog and Digital Worlds Real-world electronic devices need both analog and digital processing. That is why mixed-signal chips exist. They integrate analog and digital circuits into the same chip or system so that the two types of circuits can work together. The most typical bridge is: ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter): Converts analog signals into digital data; DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter): Converts digital data back into analog signals. The process can be simplified as: Real world → Analog signal → ADC → Digital data → Digital processing → DAC → Analog signal → Real world For example, during audio recording and playback, a microphone first converts sound into an analog electrical signal. The analog front end processes the signal, and an ADC converts it into digital data. After the digital processor stores and processes the data, a DAC converts it back into an analog signal, which is then amplified and reproduced by a speaker. A mixed-signal chip is not simply a combination of an ADC and a DAC. It may also contain: ADCs and DACs; PLLs and clock circuits; High-speed SerDes interfaces; Analog front ends; Digital calibration and control logic. These circuits need to work together within the same system, which is one reason mixed-signal design can be challenging. How Do Digital, Analog, and Mixed-Signal Chips Work Together in a Smartphone? A smartphone is a typical example of a system that combines all three types of chips. It needs to process digital data while constantly interacting with the analog signals of the real world. When You Take a Photo The image sensor converts light into electrical signals; The analog front end amplifies and processes the weak signals; The ADC converts the analog signals into digital data; The ISP performs noise reduction, white balance, and color processing; The CPU, GPU, NPU, and other digital processing units continue with computation, compression, display, and AI recognition. The overall process is essentially: Light → Analog electrical signal → Digital image data → Digital processing When You Connect to a Cellular Network The antenna receives radio-frequency signals; The RF front end amplifies, filters, and converts the signals; An ADC and related circuits convert the analog signal into digital samples; The baseband processor performs demodulation, error correction, and protocol processing. The signal path can be simplified as: Radio waves → Analog RF signal → Digital data → Baseband processing When You Charge Your Smartphone Power management and charging circuits convert and regulate the input voltage and current; The system monitors battery voltage, temperature, and charging status; Power devices handle the main energy conversion; Digital control logic adjusts the charging strategy according to system conditions. So, a smartphone is not purely a “digital device.” Digital, Analog, and Mixed-Signal Chips Compared These three types do not simply replace one another. In real electronic systems, they usually need to work together. Why Are Analog Chips Difficult to Replace? Many people see advanced digital chips with tens of billions of transistors and assume that analog chips must be relatively simple. In reality, the difficulty of analog design is not simply about transistor count. It lies in the trade-offs among device characteristics, process technology, noise, temperature, matching, and parasitic effects. Digital design can make extensive use of standard cells and automated tools. Analog circuits, however, often require repeated optimization based on process technology, device characteristics, and the application environment. The same circuit can behave differently when implemented on a different process. Even a seemingly insignificant trace in the layout can introduce additional parasitic effects, noise coupling, or matching problems. As a result, analog chip design often relies heavily on accumulated process and design experience, along with extensive verification and reliability testing. Why Do These Differences Matter in PCB Design? The differences between analog and digital circuits inside a chip also extend to PCB design. Digital circuits typically require careful consideration of signal integrity, crosstalk, clocks, and return paths, while analog circuits are more sensitive to noise, grounding, power stability, and sensitive signal integrity. For mixed signal PCB design, these issues often exist at the same time. For example, an ADC or DAC may connect to analog signals on one side and digital processing circuitry on the other. If the layout, power distribution, grounding, or return paths are not properly designed, noise generated by digital circuits can couple into sensitive analog signals. Therefore, mixed-signal PCB design often requires careful consideration of: Analog and digital circuit placement; Power and ground design; Return paths for high-speed digital signals; Noise control around ADCs and DACs; Decoupling capacitors and power integrity; Isolation between sensitive analog signals and high-speed digital signals. This is why understanding the differences between analog and digital circuits is important not only for chip designers, but also for PCB designers. Conclusion Digital chips have not replaced analog chips, and analog chips are not a “lower-end” version of digital chips. They serve different purposes: Digital chips handle computing, control, and memory. Analog chips handle sensing, amplification, and driving. Mixed-signal chips connect and translate between the two. Without digital chips, electronic devices would struggle to perform complex computations. Without analog chips, even the most powerful processor could not directly hear, see, sense, or interact with the real world. And in today's electronic devices, it is rarely one type of chip working alone. Instead, digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuits work together as one system. The smartphones, computers, vehicles, and smart devices we use every day are ultimately the result of these three worlds working together. Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac.
